_comment: Single source of the Razorpay regional prices. Read by server/core/plans.py (checkout + /api/billing/plans), by server/seo-prerender.ts (the /pricing and /refund-policy HTML a crawler sees) and by client/src/data/public-pricing.ts (the React pages). Change a price here and every surface follows. Amounts are monthly, in major units (rupees, dollars, dirhams). Annual = monthly x annual_multiplier.
